map.个税起征点为什么默认 5000？: Why is the individual income tax threshold 5000 by default?
map.四种模式分别适合什么场景？: Which scenario suits each of the four modes?
map.团队拆分：按团队总业绩×团队费率×个人份额比例分配，适合渠道/大客户团队。: Team split: allocate by team performance × team rate × individual share, suited to channel or key-account teams.
map.固定比例提成：直接按销售额×固定费率算佣金，适合客单价稳定、波动小的业务。: Flat-rate commission: commission = sales × fixed rate, suited to business with stable order value and small fluctuations.
map.固定比例适合稳定业务；阶梯累进适合要冲高业绩；底薪加提成适合新人保障；团队拆分适: Flat rate suits stable business; tiered progressive suits pushing for higher performance; base salary plus commission suits new-hire income security; team split suits collaborative large deals. All can be switched and compared on one screen.
map.工具以工资薪金月度免征额 5000 元作近似（提成并入当月工资计税更复杂，此处仅: The tool approximates the CNY 5000 monthly salary and allowance (commissions merged into that month's salary make taxation more complex, so this is reference only). In practice follow your company payroll system and the tax filing.
map.底薪加提成：设免提门槛，仅对超过门槛的超额部分计提，兼顾保障与激励。: Base salary plus commission: set a threshold and accrue commission only on the excess above it, balancing security and incentive.
map.支持固定比例、阶梯累进、底薪加提成与团队拆分四种提成模式，输入业绩自动算佣金并按: Supports four commission modes: flat rate, tiered progressive, base salary plus commission, and team split. Enter performance to get the commission and estimate tax by the cumulative withholding method, which eases sales pay accounting.

: select the "flat rate" mode with sales of 500,000 CNY and a rate of 5%.
commission = 500000 × 5% = 25000 CNY. Pre-tax income = base salary + 25000; with a zero base salary the pre-tax amount is 25000 and tax is estimated from "taxable income = 25000 − 5000 = 20000".
